## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible problem, resulting behavior and a small before/after example when helpful. Link the issue if there is one.

## Verification

List exact checks and results. Choose checks appropriate to the change using [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/bonjin-app/webguard/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md); explain skipped checks and remaining limitations. Do not include secrets, proprietary source or user data in evidence.

## Compatibility and documentation

- [ ] I considered existing API/options, SSR, browser behavior and accessibility where affected, and documented any migration or compatibility change.
- [ ] I added a behavioral regression test when behavior changed, or explained why it is not applicable.
- [ ] I updated relevant guides/API documentation and all four READMEs if installation paths, examples, release status or support boundaries changed, or marked this not applicable.

This pull request does not authorize npm publishing, deployment or stable promotion. npm publication remains paused; candidate verification is not a guarantee of compatibility with every application or browser. Report suspected security issues privately through [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/bonjin-app/webguard/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
